text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio,
please... race me! I want to see how I
match up—please, just this
once!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure, bring it on, Kita! Let me show you
just how amazing your idol
really is! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio accepts the challenge. With that in
mind, we get straight to
work...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah! More... I can still run more! Ten
more laps—no, a hundred
more laps!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna find my weapon—one only I can use! Pant, pant... Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her grit is undoubtedly impressive, and
she tackles any exercise head-on. Instead
of getting tired, the more she trains, the
more she
gets fired up.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... When it comes to incline running... I have to train at least three times harder than the others. I can keep going, I can still run...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: As many as it takes. As far as my legs allow—heck, even if they give way. The Teio agreed to run with me. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll win! I want to win! I've been given this big chance, so I want to show off something amazing and make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Actually, there won't be anyone watching this time... But, you know... there is someone I'd like to make smile...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Trainer, you've done so much
for me already!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to you that I'm here now! So
even if you're the sole
spectator, I want to
make you smile! And to do that, I need to
train more—I need to train harder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back to when Kitasan Black talked
about her dream. She said
she wanted to
inspire others through her racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, she's placing her bets on this
single race—this first step. If
this upcoming
race was a festival, she'd be a firework
lighting the way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please! Help me create my
weapon, one made just for me!
And make
it more powerful than anyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us are perfectly in sync. I
prepare the toughest training I can think
of, and she puts her all into completing
it. After training day
in, day out...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The big day finally arrives.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Kita...
is sprinting out of the gate?!
She usually holds back at
the start. Did her
trainer tell her to try front running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, that is not the case. This is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (This... is my weapon! Trainer and I made it together! I call it—Outpace the Pace Chasers!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'll set the pace of the race,
and as long
as I don't get tuckered out,
it's my win!
This race is mine for the taking!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Pant, pant, pant... I see... the final stretch! If I can hold out just a little longer...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Wait—Teio's closing in! And she's not
tired at all?! Which means...
this'll be a
speed showdown.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Is this all you've got?!
Then it's time to end
this! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Kita's falling behind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's unfortunate, but her opponent is Teio. And if the race comes down to a final burst of speed, then her chances are slim...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I've still got... fuel in the tank.
But I can't
run any faster than this... I
can't win, I can't
win—I'm gonna lose...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(This is... just like last time.
Even though I
trained so much... Am I...
going to lose...
again?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like time has stopped. No matter
how much grit she has, she
still can't win.
But at the moment when all hope seems
lost, I find myself standing up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want her to know she can do it—that her
grit is the real deal. Driven by my belief
and desire to encourage her,
I instinctively
shout—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want her to know she can do it—that her
grit is the real deal. Driven by my belief
and desire to encourage her,
I instinctively
shout—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer! You helped build me up, even
though I'm just a nobody...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Am I going to let this end without
returning the favor? Am I going to
let all
that time... all those memories... go to
waste?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I... can't let that happen. I won't let that happen. Because if I did...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then I—I wouldn't be me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You think I'll let you wiiiiin?!
Grrraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What... what is happening?! She's actually
surpassing Teio in speed!
And in the final
stretch at that!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Th-that was a close one! For a second
there, I thought I was actually
going to
lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
but I still pulled through. Nice try,
Kita, but I'm not ready to
lose to you yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: W-waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait... Kita?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Daaang iiiiit! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black surprises everyone by
bursting into tears, but I understand why.
She might normally be a well-mannered

up-and-comer, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a burning blaze inside her—an
unrivaled urge for victory. Not
a glittering
spark, but a flame a hundred—no, a
thousand times more brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I—I couldn't make you smile!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But...
I can't give up! I don't want to give
up! Next time, I swear I'll
win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! I'll keep working hard
from now and forever—and
even after
that,
too! So please be my official trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll make you smile, Trainer! Next,
the world, and then the
universe! The sky's
the limit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident that she'll reach great
heights in the future with that
kind of
unwavering conviction. Perhaps... I
misjudged her at first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought that Kita's strength was her
grit.
But what was that explosive
power she
showed off in her race against Teio?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, just maybe, her most powerful
weapon might simply be... her
ability to
work hard for the sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must say, that race was extraordinary.
What an inspiring show of
emotion... And
to think that I have her as my
underclassman, no less.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you've finally spread your wings,
Kita.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've found it—someone worth fighting
for. I can't wait to see what
the future has
in store for us!
